cornerstone.holders: GF Fund (GF Fund Management / GF Fund HK); Kaide Global Investment; Qube; Ti-Capital Funds; Value Partners (Hong Kong Limited / Value Partners Limited); Hongxing International; MSIP; HK Greenwoods; Deliante; Sunny Optical Capital; Honor; Jain Global; Seven Grand; Taikang Life; Da Cheng International; Everbright Wealth Management; GRANITE ASIA IX VCC (for GX ACCESS); Verition Multi-Strategy Master Fund Ltd.; 3W Fund
cornerstone.full_quote: Each Cornerstone Investor has agreed that without the prior written consent of our Company, the Sole Sponsor and the Overall Coordinators, it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months after the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares it has purchased, pursuant to their respective Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of the Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months after the Listing Date (“Lock-up Period”); treated as six months from the Listing Date inclusive of the Listing Date
cornerstone.notes: Wording is “six months after the Listing Date”.

controller_6m.full_quote: in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its shareholdings in the Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-Month Period”), either directly or indirectly, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the securities of the Company in respect of which it is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner; and
controller_6m.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date; restricted period ends on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (inclusive end per document wording: “ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date”); period commences on the prospectus disclosure date (H-share Rule 10.07(1)(a) form)

controller_12m.full_quote: in the period of six months from the expiry of the First Six-Month Period, either directly or indirectly, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the securities referred to in paragraph (a) above if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, they would cease to be Controlling Shareholders (as defined under the Listing Rules).
controller_12m.basis: control-preserving no-disposal undertaking covering the second six months, ending 12 months from the Listing Date (inclusive end); second period commences on expiry of the first six-month period (H-share combined Rule 10.07(1) rendering)
controller_12m.notes: Combined H-share rendering: control-preserving restriction expressed as the second six-month period clause (months 6-12).
